name: The Law
overview: Scripture reveals that the Law is holy, just, and good, serving to make us aware of sin but not providing justification by works (Romans 7:12; Romans 3:20; Galatians 2:16). Jesus affirmed that He did not come to abolish the Law but to fulfill it, highlighting its ongoing significance (Matthew 5:17). Ultimately, Christ is the culmination of the Law, bringing righteousness to those who believe, thus connecting the Law intimately with the gospel (Romans 10:4). The Law exposes sin, guides obedience, and points us to faith in Christ for true righteousness (Romans 7:7).
